mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not correlate with positive 20-day forward returns (Pearson correlation < 0.1) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < 0% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2%, it signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (PAYEMS MoM > 0% and UNRATE MoM < 0%) does not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM < -5% does not lead to negative 5-day forward returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) and Real GDP (GDPC1) both show a decline, it signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition (INDPRO QoQ < 0% and GDPC1 QoQ < 0%) does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 60% of triggered instances.
